description: An application submitted under Section 96a of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a non-material amendment in connection with the planning permission dated 26/01/2024 (Ref: 23/3341/HD) for Installation of rear dormer; alterations to roofing for repairs and maintenance; alterations to front and rear gardens including raised garden beds, demolition of existing garden store, construction of new garden store, and other associated landscaping; Installation of two (2) skylights to the existing ground floor rear addition; Installation of two (2) new skylights to the front roof slope; Installation of one (1) new skylight to rear roof slope; Alterations to the material finish of the dwelling including the removal of exterior blinds; Installation of air-conditioning unit and solar panels; and associated interior and exterior alterations, to allow:    - Changing the window size to a larger one in opaque glazing on the north elevation (utility plant area).
